performance.interpretation: Every complete attempt is scored independently. Pooled values describe the samples; they cannot override a failed attempt. 1440p is the output buffer; dynamic scale is recorded per racing frame. Native here means real RAF with normal browser pacing in an isolated headless Chromium, not foreground physical-display or human driving proof. Unrelated owner apps were not stopped. Timing variability is not attributed to a proven host or software cause.

rejectedExperiment.description: A vehicle transparency cache preserved back/front rendering (eight A/B views differed by at most nine pixels by one channel level), but did not establish a meaningful sustained improvement. Removed before the final package. Candidate measurements and diagnostic sources remain in .tools/phase2-close-package-* and .tools/phase2-close-rejected; they are not final acceptance evidence.

evidenceTransfer: Raw frame arrays, failures, captures and diagnostics are retained locally under ignored .tools; this tracked receipt retains their hashes and summaries. No review archive was created.
